title: Why You Can't Just Paint Your Front Door

pre.en: Why was Margaret unhappy with her new front door?
pre.zh: Margaret 为什么对新门不满意？
options: It took two years to arrive.
It had to be the same colour as the old one.

intro: 一段对话：小陈夸 Margaret 家的新前门漂亮，Margaret 就讲起约克的老房子为什么不能随便改——先说规定，再说为什么要有这些规定，最后讲她自己换门的经历。读的时候留意情态动词的被动：must be sent、can't be fitted、can be fined，说规定里「必须、不能、可能」被怎么样。

sentences.en: Margaret, your front door's lovely.
sentences.zh: Margaret，您家前门真漂亮。
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: Is it new?
sentences.zh: 是新换的吗？

sentences.en: Fairly new, and it wasn't easy, love.
sentences.zh: 算是新的吧，可费了好大劲儿呢，小伙子。
sentences.speaker: Margaret

sentences.en: This is a listed building.
sentences.zh: 这是一栋受保护的历史建筑。

sentences.en: York has more than two thousand of them, and they're protected by law.
sentences.zh: 约克有两千多座这样的房子，都受法律保护。

sentences.en: So what does that mean?
sentences.zh: 那是什么意思？
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: It means you aren't allowed to just do what you like.
sentences.zh: 意思就是，你不能想怎么弄就怎么弄。
sentences.speaker: Margaret

sentences.en: If you want to make changes to the house, you have to ask the council first.
sentences.zh: 想对房子做任何改动，都得先问市政厅。

sentences.en: Even for a brass door knocker.
sentences.zh: 连换个黄铜门环都要问。

sentences.en: No way.
sentences.zh: 不会吧。
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: Oh yes.
sentences.zh: 真的。
sentences.speaker: Margaret

sentences.en: Before any work starts, plans must be sent to the council and approved by an officer.
sentences.zh: 动工之前，方案必须先交到市政厅，还得由专门的官员批准。

sentences.en: Repairs should be done with traditional materials, and plastic windows usually can't be fitted.
sentences.zh: 修缮要用传统材料，塑料窗一般不让装。

sentences.en: According to the council's website, owners who ignore the rules can be fined thousands of pounds.
sentences.zh: 据市政厅网站说，不守规矩的房主可能被罚好几千英镑。

sentences.en: How long does it take to get permission to do the work?
sentences.zh: 那拿到施工许可要多久？
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: It depends, but a few months is normal.
sentences.zh: 看情况，不过几个月很正常。
sentences.speaker: Margaret

sentences.en: So it's worth planning ahead.
sentences.zh: 所以最好早做打算。

sentences.en: To be honest, it all sounds a bit strict.
sentences.zh: 说实话，听着有点太严了。
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: Maybe, but in the 1960s, lots of old houses had fallen apart, or were knocked down for roads and car parks.
sentences.zh: 也许吧，可在六十年代，好多老房子要么已经破败不堪，要么被拆掉修了马路和停车场。
sentences.speaker: Margaret

sentences.en: Since then, hundreds of buildings have been saved.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，几百栋建筑被保了下来。

sentences.en: And in the long run, the rules are good for the city.
sentences.zh: 从长远看，这些规定对城市是好事。

sentences.en: They keep the old streets in good condition, and they bring in eight million tourists a year.
sentences.zh: 老街能一直保持得好好的，每年还能招来八百万游客。

sentences.en: Fair enough.
sentences.zh: 也有道理。
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: So what happened with your door?
sentences.zh: 那您家的门是怎么回事？

sentences.en: I applied two years ago and sent them three pages about the old one.
sentences.zh: 两年前我递了申请，还给他们写了整整三页，讲那扇旧门的来历。
sentences.speaker: Margaret

sentences.en: Forty years of teaching history came in handy.
sentences.zh: 教了四十年历史，这下可派上用场了。

sentences.en: Decisions should be made within eight weeks, but my application was never on track.
sentences.zh: 按规定八周内就该给答复，可我的申请就没按时推进过。

sentences.en: Every few weeks, someone promised to let me know "very soon".
sentences.zh: 每隔几个星期，就有人答应「很快」给我回音。

sentences.en: I was about to give up when they finally got round to it last spring.
sentences.zh: 我都准备放弃了，结果去年春天他们总算处理了。

sentences.en: And they said yes?
sentences.zh: 然后批了？
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: Yes, but there was one condition.
sentences.zh: 批了，但有一个条件。
sentences.speaker: Margaret

sentences.en: It had to be painted exactly the same dark green as the old one.
sentences.zh: 新门必须漆成跟旧门一模一样的深绿色。

sentences.en: Well, at least you've got a new door.
sentences.zh: 那至少您换上新门了。
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: I have.
sentences.zh: 是啊。
sentences.speaker: Margaret

sentences.en: In exactly the colour I wanted to get rid of.
sentences.zh: 还是我最想甩掉的那个颜色。

cards.note: listed building 是英国受法律保护的历史建筑，改动要先申请；分 Grade I、II* 和 II 三级。
to have permission to do something
cards.tip: 否定 aren't allowed to 是「不许」，比 can't 更强调规定；后面接动词原形。
cards.example: Visitors aren't allowed to take photos inside the museum.

cards.note: to change parts of something
cards.tip: 介词用 to，不用 on / for：make changes to the code。小改动说 make small changes。
cards.example: I've made a few changes to the design — can you have a look?

cards.note: 英国的城市、郡由 council 管理，收垃圾、批建房都归它管。
动词 knock 敲门；英国老房子的前门上常装一个金属门环。
名词 approval；approve of sb / sth 是「赞成」，意思不同。
名词 tradition；traditional food 传统食物。
as shown by a report, a study or what someone has said
cards.tip: 后面接消息来源，不接 me：说自己的看法用 in my opinion，不说 according to me。
cards.example: According to the weather app, it'll rain all weekend.

cards.note: 当名词也是「罚款」：pay a fine；和形容词 fine（好的）是同一个拼写。
to be told officially that you can do something
cards.tip: permission 不可数，不说 a permission；向谁要许可是 from sb：get permission from the council。
cards.example: We need to get permission to use their photos.

cards.note: used to say that the answer will change because of something else
to make plans for something before it happens
a strict teacher 严厉的老师；strict rules 严格的规定。
to break into pieces because it is old or badly made
cards.tip: fall 的过去式 fell，过去分词 fallen；人也能 fall apart，是「崩溃」。
cards.example: My old trainers are falling apart.

cards.note: after a long period of time, in the future
cards.tip: 常放在句首或句末；反义是 in the short run / in the short term。
cards.example: Writing tests takes time, but it saves time in the long run.

cards.note: not damaged, and working or looking as it should
cards.tip: condition 前不加 a：in good condition / in poor condition；二手买卖常用。
cards.example: The car is ten years old, but it's still in good condition.

cards.note: to be useful, especially when you did not expect it to be
making good progress and likely to finish on time

cards.zh: 告诉某人一声；通知某人
cards.note: to tell someone about something
cards.tip: know 前面不加 to：let me know，不说 let me to know；后面可接 if / when 从句。
cards.example: Let me know when you get home.

cards.note: to be going to happen or do something very soon
to finally do something that you have wanted or planned to do for a long time
cards.tip: to 是介词，后面接名词或 doing：get round to doing sth；美式英语说 get around to。
cards.example: I finally got round to fixing the kitchen light.

cards.note: to throw away, sell or give away something you do not want
